spec.moment: The team's first world finally renders at sunset, and everyone screams around the crowded table by the window.

elements.name: the first rendered world
elements.look: a small glowing globe of tiny hills and trees hovering on a laptop screen, warm light spilling out

elements.name: the crowded table by the window
elements.look: a long wooden table pushed against a tall window, cluttered with laptops and cables

elements.name: the team
elements.look: three small simple figures in hoodies and t-shirts, one in a red cap, arms up mid-cheer

elements.name: slim silver energy-drink cans
elements.look: a cluster of tall slim silver cans, some tipped over, catching the sunset

elements.name: Danny
elements.look: a small figure in a blue sweater leaning over the table, one hand pointing at the screen

spec.scene: A patch of grey office carpet holds a long wooden table pushed to a tall window at the back, orange sunset light pouring through it. At the center the table is crowded with laptops, one screen glowing with a tiny colorful world of hills and trees. Three small cheering figures in hoodies stand around it, one in a red cap, another in a blue sweater pointing. Slim silver cans scatter across the tabletop. At the front, an open pizza box with pale slices sits on the floor, its cardboard flaps folded back.
spec.title: First World Renders
spec.caption: We screamed when the first little world lit up at sunset. Cold pizza never tasted better.
